Avery (People Ops): Hey team — quick heads-up: next all-hands is Thu 10am PT (in-person + Zoom). Agenda below and a couple of asks. Please drop any Qs here or use the Q&A form by Tue EOD.

Avery (People Ops): Agenda (30m total):
• 10m — Exec update + company health metrics (Zoe)
• 6m — Product: Playbook launch + go-to-market checklist (Priya)
• 5m — Eng: runtime performance quick wins & rollout timeline (Yamir)
• 4m — Security & compliance note on data retention policy (Marcus)
• 5m — Ops: Dedicated capacity pricing adjustment + support plan (Lena)
• 0-?m — Live Q&A (we may run a few extra minutes)

Avery (People Ops): Two asks: 1) If you want to demo something, reply here with a 1-sentence blurb + runtime requirements. 2) Submit any sensitive Qs to the form (anonymized option): https://forms.redwood.internal/ah-qna

Yamir (Eng): Can we reserve the last 2 slides for a 2-min demo of the prefetch cache change? low-risk, shows 15% p99 improve.

Avery (People Ops): @Yamir — noted. Can you send a 1-slide deck to me by Wed noon and ping here when uploaded?

Priya (Product): Requesting a 2-slide slot for launch metrics and a single callout about downstream integrations. Will send slides by Wed 3pm.

Marcus (Security): Heads-up — we'll read out a short policy tweak to data retention for logs. Non-blocking but want to flag for teams using long-term KV caches.

Lena (Sales): We'll include high-level customer questions in the doc. Also: can we add a 30s mention of the new partner integration? Helps surface to GTM folks.

Avery (People Ops): Good call @Lena — adding a 30s partner mention after product.

Yamir (Eng): Small ask: can Eng have the meeting link pinned in the calendar invite? demos need screen share perms.

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "All-Hands — Playbook Launch" Thu 10:00 PT — Zoom link pinned to calendar.

Avery (People Ops): Recording will be posted to #all-hands-recordings and the internal drive after the meeting. If you need segs clipped for your team, DM me and we'll surface timestamps.

Ops Bot: Note: please use the breakout request form if you need a breakout room for >10 people during all-hands week: https://ops.redwood.internal/breakouts

Priya (Product): One more thing — will we surface the new launch playbook link during the call? https://confluence.redwood.internal/playbooks/launch-2026

Avery (People Ops): Yes — we'll link the playbook in the chat and in the follow-up email.

Marcus (Security): Quick Q from security: will the retention policy change affect Dedicated customers?

Avery (People Ops): Short answer: no immediate change to customer-facing defaults. Marcus will have the exact scope in his 4-minute slot.

Lena (Sales): For heads-up: timeline for pricing adjustment that's on the agenda — we may need a bundle FAQ for renewals. @Finance/RevOps — can you prepare one-pager?

Avery (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Reminder: submit slide deck updates to the shared folder: drive.redwood.internal/allhands/may-2026. Drop a message here once done. Looking forward to a brisk show-and-tell. :sparkles:
